swete-introduction: Henry Barclay Swete, An Introduction to the Old Testament in Greek (Cambridge, 1900; revised 1902; 2nd ed. 1914), pages 222–223 and 265–267 on 1 Esdras, read at archive.org
bullard-hatton-esdras: Roger A. Bullard and Howard A. Hatton, A Handbook on 1–2 Esdras, UBS Helps for Translators (United Bible Societies, 2019), introduction to 1 Esdras, read at tips.translation.bible
jerome-preface-ezra: Jerome, Preface to the Books of Ezra and Nehemiah in his Latin translation from the Hebrew, trans. Mark DelCogliano (2004, public domain), read at tertullian.org
vulgate-clementine-preface: Praefatio ad lectorem (trium editionum Clementinarum), the preface to the reader of the Sixto-Clementine Vulgate, reprinted in the appendix of the Nova Vulgata, Latin text read at vatican.va
russian-synodal-azbyka: The Russian Synodal Bible, "2-я книга Ездры" (the second book of Ezra), and its list of Old Testament books, which marks this book with an asterisk as неканоническая (non-canonical), as printed at azbyka.ru
mihaila-anaginoskomena: Alexandru Mihăilă, "The Orthodox Bible and the Anaginoskomena Books of the Old Testament," Romanian Orthodox Old Testament Studies 4, no. 2 (2020): 26–43 (abstract read at ceeol.com)
luther-bible-1534: Martin Luther, Biblia, das ist die gantze Heilige Schrifft Deudsch (Wittenberg: Hans Lufft, 1534), title page and list of the Apocrypha, image read at the Gruber Collection of the Lutheran School of Theology at Chicago (gruber.lstc.edu)
orthodox-study-bible: The Orthodox Study Bible (St. Athanasius Academy of Orthodox Theology; Thomas Nelson), its introduction and "The Old Testament Books Listed and Compared," read at azbyka.ru
gallagher-vulgate-appendix: Ed Gallagher, "The Vulgate Appendix," Sanctus Hieronymus blog (23 July 2018), giving the Latin note at the head of the appendix of the Sixto-Clementine Vulgate (1592) with his translation, read at sanctushieronymus.blogspot.com
